reason: I have to replace the volume we lost last quarter, and this is the first offer where I see the 15 companies before I pay anything and the first 3 meetings cost nothing. I'll do the free step and probably the pilot, but I'm expecting to be disappointed.
objection: I've paid consultants before and got slides. One logistics client with 45 meetings tells me nothing about whether a manufacturer like us gets real buyers, and I don't believe 3 hours is all it takes my team, who have no time for this.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 target companies in step 1 are names we already know or obviously wrong for our product, I stop there.
